comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: This change has been deployed. This is the first release repository to be created with a default template (#499) which should smooth out recent issues with GitHub release repositories and bloom. Please open a new issue on https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org if you have any problems. Thanks!
